prompt:
He was here. Last night. Right here.
She’s lying. She’s with him. He sent her.
Don’t answer him. Ever.
You wanted to know.
He was coming for me. You stood up. And then… it wasn’t quite you.
You saved me, stupid.
Right. Sure.
You went through my stuff.
“Like before” — when you erased his mom.
Noah. Run.
Do what you think is right.
No.
Run!
Noah!
Danny. Come here, to me.
We’re here.
How did you know?
The ice is dark over there. Don’t go near it.
She used to braid my hair here. I thought I’d dreamed that.
I was four. I remember Mom’s hands. And everything smelled like the lake.
No. Not today. Please — remember.
You remember?
That night you told me not to go to the lake alone. Well, I’m not alone.
I have. And I’ve read about you. In Mom’s diary.
Noah, don’t!
Zoe, don’t fall asleep! Please… I’m not losing anyone else today.
Three years. The judge said you were protecting me.
Eight years. The judge said that with Dad, you were protecting me. But the rest…
They let him go. It’s okay. I won’t be a kid forever.
Everyone thinks he just drowned. Let them. I know.
I’ll visit. Every week.
I drew how it’s going to be.
I can’t. Not yet. But I’ll come again.
Where is he? Where’s my brother?
You’re with Mom now. And I’m still here. I’ll live for both of us.
Was it her?

You keep it. You decide.
What did you see?
I believe her.
Iris… maybe you’re right.
Enough. Both of you.
I’m sorry.
That wasn’t me.
Thanks for telling me.
Don’t tell anyone about this, okay?
If anyone asks — tell the truth. How it was.
What happened to my mother?
You were there. That night. I saw your car.
Iris. Give him the diary.
Into the woods! Everyone — go!
…I don’t know.
Do you remember what it was like here?
Last time I was here, I was eight.
You knew? That it was him?
I won’t.
I don’t know. But I’ll try.
That was Grandma. And Iris.
Iris… give me one.
I’m sorry. There’s nothing there.
I remember.
Mom was waiting for you that night. Bags packed. You promised to get her out. And he showed up instead.
She kept looking at the boathouse, right to the end. So I wouldn’t come out.
He held her under. For a long time. And you wrote “accidental drowning.”
I didn’t look. But I heard everything.
And then you opened the boathouse and told me I’d dreamed it.
You helped yourself.
I don’t know what happened back then. But I’m not giving you Iris.
Your jacket! Get it off!
He’s going to answer for this.
Get your chest on the ice! Kick with your legs!
No. No sleeping today. Sing. The one you sang in the car.
I believe you. You hear me? I believe you.
Zoe. It’s me.
Stay awake! You hear me? Stay awake!
You drew us?

Hasn’t started in eight years. You’re the mechanic, aren’t you?
Don’t you dare. Don’t you dare call me by my name.
Go. Go on, I said. I’m old. I’ll hold him off.
It was you who told him. About Annie. You gave her away.
Stay off the ice by the dock. There’s springs under there — it won’t hold, not even in a hard freeze.
She was happy here. Summers. Till that man came rolling in.
I knew. And I kept my mouth shut. Eleven years, sonny.
Then she’s with you.
That’s not Anna! That’s not her!
Get down! Flat on your belly, sonny!
She’s let go.
She took what was hers. Now she’ll let go.
The lake keeps its own. Now they’re together down there.

Okay. Since we’re all here… in one old van.
Quiet Pines. A sanatorium in the woods. White, pretty. There were about ten of us. I was nineteen.
You know who they put in there? People who saw something.
I don’t remember. That’s the whole point. Mom paid, and I don’t remember.
All I remember is my stepdad got really nice after that.
Gee, thanks.
Run! Go, all of you, run!
Noah!
What is this, a harpoon? It’s pretty here. Creepy, but pretty.
When I was eight, I got a hamster. It died. Sorry. I talk crap when I’m nervous.
Just come back, okay? From wherever it is you go.
Is it Thursday…?
At least somebody does…
Oh. It’s you… I thought it was the white room again.

Noah. This is Dr. Hale. Zoe is with me. She’s fine — as long as she takes her medication.
Let’s talk like adults. No axes.
Let’s talk like adults.
Noah. At last.
Agnessa… It’s been so long.
I understand, you’re frightened. You’re ill, Noah, and you know it.
You killed your father. She’ll be next.
Come with me. I’ll help. Like before.
An accident, Noah. You were asleep. You couldn’t have seen it.
Take him.
Come on, Noah.
Well then.
Take him.
Thank you. And now — you.
Good boy.
Noah… I’m not angry. It’s cold out here. Come out — let’s talk.
Agnessa, don’t. You know I’m a doctor.
Danny. Danny, come here. Your mom’s in the car. She’s looking for you.
Go inside, Vic. Get changed. I’ll take care of it.
Noah… You were asleep. Do you hear me? You were asleep. You dreamed it.
Here, take this. It’ll all be gone by morning.
You were in the boathouse. Whatever you saw in there, Noah, it was a dream. We’ve been through this a hundred times.
How’s the head? Took your pill? Good boy. See? Better already.
Here’s your truth. Paper.
Go on, take it. It’s all weather and recipes.
Iris, sweetheart, step away from him. You’ve seen what he can do.
Look at the shore, Noah. Zoe’s had a lot of medication. In this cold, that’s dangerous — she needs a doctor. Come with me, and everyone goes home.
Look at the shore. Danny’s frozen stiff. Come with me, and I’ll take him to his mom.
There’s a good boy.
I… I only told him. I was scared, Noah. He would have… I never thought he’d…
You were eight. You screamed every night. I helped you.
Iris is coming with me. She needs help too.
That’s a shame. Then Iris is coming with me. She needs help too.
Noah. Noah, stop. Look at me. You know me.
Noah… Noah, please…
Noah… Your hand…
Take her inside, she needs to get warm.
Take the boy inside, he’s freezing.
Get some sleep, Noah.
That dream again? Don’t worry. We’ll take care of it.

At the gas station… You weren’t angry. You were… like you weren’t there. Empty eyes.
And then you told the man, “sleep.” Real quiet. Like my mom says it.
He fell. Hit his head. On the… counter. You cried after. You didn’t mean it.
Okay.
Found it in the boathouse. Just in case. You won’t leave us, right?

Sorry, I never even said thank you. You… well, you know.
And you. Don’t argue.

Uncle Simon will be here soon, and then we’re going to Grandma’s. Shh, Iris is sleeping.
Noah, into the boathouse. Quick. Quiet as a mouse, no matter what.
…He promised.

Going somewhere? Simon told me everything. Called me himself. Good friend, Simon.
She fell. You hear me? She slipped. All on her own.
